Game Overview

In Bongio, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a thrilling journey in Bongio, where agility and strategy are your best allies. Dodge deceptive traps and rolling boulders as you collect coins and stars. Conquer progressively challenging levels, with progress saved until you start anew. Can you master the art of outmaneuvering danger?
